activation_policy: EVERY candidate here is status=under_review and needs_reviewer=true. None of these may be written into tax_rules with status='active'. Activation requires a verified official_source AND an approved tax_rule_reviews row with a licensed reviewer, per server/lib/taxGate.js. Values marked confidence=low were read from DJP guidance page summaries, NOT from the primary regulation text, and must be confirmed against the PMK/PP.

evidence_rule_candidates.what_it_proves: the obligation exists and its amount
evidence_rule_candidates.notes: NEEDS OFFICIAL SOURCE for any legally-required field list. Fields above are product requirements, not law.

evidence_rule_candidates.what_it_proves: VAT was charged and is potentially creditable
evidence_rule_candidates.risk_if_missing: input VAT may not be creditable
evidence_rule_candidates.notes: Still NOT supported for required fields. The primary PPN text (KEMENKEU_PPN_002) is a nilai-lain regulation and does not define faktur pajak content. No PER on faktur pajak was located. GAP REMAINS.

evidence_rule_candidates.what_it_proves: that tax was withheld, by whom, and through which reporting channel

evidence_rule_candidates.notes: SUPPORTED by fetch-verified pages: DJP_PPH23_002 states a bukti potong is issued via e-bupot for PPh 23; DJP_PPH42_002 states it is issued via e-SPT for PPh 4(2). The REQUIRED-FIELD list is still unsourced: the Coretax bukti potong manual (DJP_BUPOT_001) was archived but has no text layer and was not read.

evidence_rule_candidates.notes: UNCHANGED and still unsourced. No official Indonesian source was found in this pass stating that a payment proof is legally required. It remains an accounting control we choose to enforce, and the KB must not imply otherwise.
